start.description: start date for the data point

outlierCode.description:
outlierCode: 0 or no value -- regular point
             1 -- to be ignored when returning results of value outlier analysis
             2 -- is an estimated value
             3 -- combination of 1 and 2 together

enum (0, 1, 2)

comments.description: (Optional) any comments for the data point

isEstimated.description: Denotes if the value is an actual value or an estimated value. default = null (actual value)

dataVersion.description:
Same data points can have different data version to denote priority. Default behavior in case of overlapping
data points is to pick the data point with the highest data version.
If data version is not specified, then default (avg) overlap handling is applied to the overalapping data points

statusCode.description: Customer specific status code for the data point (may be used to denote data quality)

typeIdent.description:
Indicates explicit sub-type of entry.  Composed of the concatenation of the typeKey of the instance's type and all
of its base type's typeIdent

id.description:
A unique identifier that can be manually assigned or generated automatically during object creation. This
identifier cannot be altered after the object has been persisted.

version.description:
Version number used for optimistic concurrency.  Automatically managed by the system.

Updating an Obj with a null or 0 value for version will cause the concurrency check to be skipped and should only
be done with great caution.

typeWithBindings.description: Persists concrete type with bindings for generic types where instance has parameter bindings

value.description:
Represents the predicted value from the model.
This value could be the output of a machine learning model, a risk prediction, or other types of assessments.

`@ts(treatmentPath="parent.treatment", unitPath="parent.unitConstraint")`
- Specifies the path to retrieve the treatment and unit constraints from the parent entity.
The treatment may involve applying adjustments, scaling, or interpretation rules specific to the model's context.

valueUpperBound.description:
The upper bound for the predicted value.
This defines the maximum allowed value for the prediction, used to ensure the value does not exceed a certain threshold.
The upper bound could be applied in scenarios where there are known safety limits, business constraints, or operational boundaries.

valueLowerBound.description:
The lower bound for the predicted value.
This defines the minimum allowed value for the prediction, helping to ensure that the predicted values don't fall below a defined threshold.
This can be particularly important in systems where predictions below a certain value do not make sense or could be deemed invalid.

title:
Represents a model prediction or assessment related to reliability or other predictive applications.
This entity type captures the predicted value, along with upper and lower bounds for that value, providing a
means for tracking the prediction over time, and validating its limits within a given range.
This entity mixes `TimedDataPoint` to include time-series functionality and `ReliabilityMl.PredictionHeader`
for additional metadata related to the prediction.
For details on other information stored in this Type, refer to the documentation on each of the fields of this Type.
name: ReliabilityMl.Prediction
